name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
description: Create a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high storm Cylinder. Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast spells with Verbal components. When the storm appears, or when a creature first enters or ends a turn there, it makes a Constitution save and takes 2d10 Radiant plus 2d10 Thunder damage on a failure, or half on a success, once per turn. **Higher-Level Slots.** Each damage type increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.
